summary: UFinancial Accounting & Tax is the accounting arm of UFinancial, a Melbourne group at 580 St Kilda Rd that is mainly mortgage broking and financial planning with property advisory and accounting alongside. Nathan Romeo leads accounting and tax, is a Xero Certified Advisor, and published a tax article in October 2026 plus a property CGT explainer in September 2026. The firm lists a Senior Accountant opening and its accounting team is small, around seven people on the site.

hooks.text: Nathan's October 2026 article on side-hustle and online-selling income shows his client base includes platform sellers and online businesses with high transaction counts.
Small accounting team (about seven) inside a much larger mortgage and planning group, with a Senior Accountant opening: capacity is tight, so time back from reconciliation matters.
Xero Certified Advisor, so a Xero-native pitch lands without explanation.

risks.text: Accounting is a sub-division of a mortgage-led group; the tooling decision may sit with group leadership rather than Nathan.
Headcounts conflict: LinkedIn says 53 people while the About page claims 145+ employees across 8 national offices; the accounting team itself is only about seven.
Nathan holds a second directorship (NVESTED Group, which holds the UFinancial Accounting & Tax business name), so he is the owner-operator of this practice and likely time-poor.

gaps: No podcast, YouTube, Facebook or Instagram content found for Nathan or the accounting arm.
No Dext, Hubdoc or reconciliation-tool mentions found.
The Senior Accountant opening has no job description page, so duties are unknown.
The About page employee count (145+) could not be reconciled with LinkedIn; it was not used as a claim.
